root: Stream junction producer construction omitted by nested control-region dispatcher
observation: M11442 compiles original nested mouse joins on Windows/Linux; current V11452 and prior V11423 both generate a use of undefined EventStream producer SSA. Join pull/next/drop functions exist, but value construction for the same junction is absent.
sourceDecision: CSharp EmitExpression universally dispatches StreamJoinExpression to EmitRuntimeStreamJoinExpression. SLG ordinary function and entry paths dispatch kind43; emitRegionControlExpressions used by nested when arms and region value roots has no kind43 handler. Share planned join-value dispatch across all three paths; preserve original fixture and all policy/type/ownership decisions.
